description: Bundled type-spec for reporting's smallest, logic-free types: the Caveat and CaseStudySelection dataclasses and the ReportNotAvailable exception. Grouped into one file (RunReport, CaseStudy and FunnelSummary each get their own file since they carry real structural/derivation logic worth documenting at length; these do not).
docstring:
Caveat: One fixed interpretive caveat (ARCHITECTURE.md 'Known Limitations' item). key is a stable identifier (e.g. 'steamspy_owner_confidence', 'boxleiter_approximation', 'simplicity_proxy', 'no_scraping_demand_gap', 'survivorship_bias', 'competition_historical', 'coarse_filter_boundary' -- one per limitation 1-7, plus the dynamic 'archetype_cap_relaxed' key that select_case_studies can trigger). severity is one of 'info' | 'warning', all seven ARCHITECTURE.md limitations being informational-but-important rather than error-level, since they describe the method, not a run defect.

CaseStudySelection: select_case_studies' return type. Wraps the ranked, diversity-capped case_studies list together with archetype_cap_relaxed, a bool recording whether the one-time max_per_archetype+1 relaxation fired. load_run_report unwraps this: RunReport.case_studies is assigned selection.case_studies directly (a plain list[CaseStudy], so RunReport's own shape is unaffected), and when archetype_cap_relaxed is True, load_run_report appends one extra Caveat(key='archetype_cap_relaxed', severity='info') to RunReport.caveats.

ReportNotAvailable: Raised by load_run_report when run_id does not exist at all (storage.get_run returns None). NOT raised for a run that exists but has no analysis results yet (that is the is_partial=True path) -- ReportNotAvailable specifically means 'no such run', not 'run incomplete'.
preconditions: Caveat.key values are unique across the fixed set returned by interpretive_caveats
postconditions: interpretive_caveats() always returns Caveat instances with stable, never-renamed key values across code versions, since the UI may persist/reference them by key
ReportNotAvailable's message names the run_id that was not found

edge_cases.expected_behavior: not produced by interpretive_caveats in v1; 'error' is not in the allowed severity set for this fixed, method-level caveat list

unit_tests.name: test_caveat_severity_constrained
unit_tests.description: Every Caveat produced by interpretive_caveats has severity in {'info','warning'}.
